title: Humanoid HUB esp aimbot fov
features:
What's up. Dropping the V8.6 update for Humanoid Hub. Honestly, the older versions with Chams and Skeleton ESP were frying potato PCs because of the constant raycasting. So, I completely stripped the heavy stuff out. This version is built for pure, raw performance. 0 FPS drops.

Features:

Raw Performance ESP: Just clean Boxes and Distance [meters]. No heavy raycasting, no lag. Boxes turn Neon Cyan when you lock onto a target so you know exactly who you're shooting.

No-Shake Aimbot (RMB): Added a proper mathematical deadzone. The aimbot actually sticks to the head without spazzing out or vibrating. Includes 0.045 velocity prediction and wallbang support.

Modal UI Fix: If you play FPS games where the camera locks your mouse, you know the struggle. I added a true modal unlocker so your custom Gojo-Purple cursor glides smoothly over the UI without the game fighting you.

Lite-Fullbright: Clean ambient lighting, no deep-fried white screens.
